service.description: A forecast's key, each part optional where a service says so: the organization (of the caller's scope, else the default one), the internal party (a person who works for it, one of its sales teams or the organization itself; else the caller), the time period (a Sales or Fiscal period of the organization; else its Sales quarter holding today) and the currency (else the organization's base currency).

Forecast's slice (design §8 ForecastMetrics, ForecastDeals): a stored forecast by id, or a key, as of a time (now by default). Its measures, each labelled: the quota and its basis, the open and the weighted pipeline (qualified open deals expected to close in the period, in the key's currency), open and won monthly recurring revenue, the submitted forecast and best case, the won amount (deals closed won in the period, not invoiced revenue), placed orders and finalized invoices by their own dates, and for the organization's key the orders and invoices with no representative. The deals read are those of the key's party and of its descendant forecasts' parties at the as-of time, each once, of those the reader sees; each deal is listed with whether it counts and the reason one is left out (a lead, no expected close, no amount, no probability, another currency), paged. Also the child forecasts with their own judgement (never added to the parent's), the product and category allocations and what the caller may do. No percentage on a zero quota. Refuses a caller who reads no Sales (PERMISSION_DENIED), an organization outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED), a party that is no person, team or the organization (SUBJECT_INVALID), a period that is not the organization's (PERIOD_INVALID), an unknown currency (CURRENCY_INVALID) and a forecast the caller does not see (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: noPeriod
parameter.description: No period was named and the organization has no sales period holding today: nothing to show

service.description: SubmitForecast (design §8): the caller's judgement on a key, its forecast amount and best case (not below the forecast) with a reason kept in the audit log, and when and by whom it was entered. A stored forecast is named by its id and the revision read; a key with no forecast yet makes one. Refuses a caller without SALES_FORECAST_EDIT or a key not theirs to judge (their own, a team they manage, or with SALES_TEAM_VIEW a team or the organization; PERMISSION_DENIED), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), a key that has a forecast already (FORECAST_EXISTS), no forecast amount (AMOUNT_REQUIRED), a negative or too precise amount (AMOUNT_INVALID, CURRENCY_PRECISION), a best case below the forecast (BEST_CASE_INVALID) and a forecast below its allocations (DETAIL_OVER_FORECAST), with the key's refusals of get#Forecast.

ForecastDetail (design §8): an allocation of a forecast's judgement to a product or a category (one of them), an amount and a quantity with its unit, or its removal (remove with its sequence id), at the forecast's revision. The allocations never add up to more than the forecast, and a product is never counted both directly and through a category it is a member of. Refuses a forecast the caller does not see (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) or may not judge (PERMISSION_DENIED), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), neither or both of a product and a category (DIMENSION_REQUIRED), an unknown one (PRODUCT_INVALID, CATEGORY_INVALID), an overlap (DETAIL_OVERLAP), no amount or quantity (AMOUNT_REQUIRED), an amount before the forecast is submitted (FORECAST_REQUIRED) and allocations over the forecast (DETAIL_OVER_FORECAST).

SalesTargets (design §9 Targets): a key's target, its quota, the basis it is measured on (won opportunity value by default, placed sales order value or finalized sales invoice value) and its parent forecast in the team hierarchy (clearParent to remove it), the reason kept in the audit log; changing a target never changes the measured actuals. A new key (organization, internal party and period required) makes its forecast; a stored one is named by id and revision, its key unchanged. Refuses a caller without SALES_TEAM_MANAGE or a key they do not see (PERMISSION_DENIED), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), a key that has a forecast already (DUPLICATE_KEY), no quota (AMOUNT_REQUIRED), another basis (BASIS_INVALID), a parent not of the same organization, period and currency or not seen (PARENT_INVALID) and a hierarchy cycle (HIERARCHY_CYCLE), with the key's refusals of get#Forecast.

SalesTargets' list (design §9 Targets): the targets of an organization (the default one when none is named), of a period when named, the caller sees, with their party, period, currency, quota, basis, parent, submitted forecast, revision and whether the caller may change them, and whether the organization has periods; with includeForecasts the forecasts with no quota too. Refuses a caller who reads no Sales (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an organization outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

parameter.name: periodsFound
parameter.description: Whether the organization has a sales or fiscal period

service.description: TargetAttainment (design §8 TargetOptions, TargetResults): each target of an organization, period and currency the caller sees (narrowed to one target and those below it, and to a basis, when named), as of a time: its quota, the submitted forecast, the actual on the one basis the target names (won opportunity value, placed sales order value or finalized sales invoice value, never added together), the variance, the percentage (none for a zero quota) and the count of source records; and, for a reader of the organization's whole pipeline, the orders and invoices with no representative apart. Counts only the deals, orders and invoices the reader sees; no template or recurring base. Refuses a caller without SALES_REPORT_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED), an organization outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED), a period not the organization's (PERIOD_INVALID), an unknown currency (CURRENCY_INVALID) or basis (BASIS_INVALID) and a target not seen (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: noPeriod
parameter.description: No period was named and the organization has none holding today

service.description: The sales periods of an organization's calendar year (this year by default): its Sales year, four quarters and twelve months, each made only when the organization has none of its type starting that day, the quarters under the year and the months under their quarter. Refuses a caller who is neither a sales manager (SALES_TEAM_MANAGE) nor the Sales administrator (SALES_CONFIGURE; PERMISSION_DENIED), an organization outside the scope or not internal (ORGANIZATION_DENIED) and a year outside 2000 to 2100 (YEAR_INVALID).

PipelineAnalysis (design §8 PipelineMeasures, PipelineFunnel): the open qualified deals a Sales report reader sees, as they stood at the as-of time (now by default; each field from its audit log), under the filters (organization, team, owner, pipeline, stage, source, campaign, account, currency, expected close period), grouped by stage, source, owner or age band and by currency: count, estimated and weighted amount, monthly recurring amount, average age, missing estimates and next-activity coverage (open tasks now), never added across currencies; the open leads counted apart. Stage durations from the audited stage changes up to the time, reopenings included, a stay whose entry or exit the log does not show counted unknown, never guessed. Lead conversion over the leads created between cohortFrom and cohortThru (the 90 days to the time by default): created, qualified (convertedDate), disqualified, still open, won. The funnel's steps visits (Marketing's count#SalesVisits when it exists, else not available), leads, qualified and won, as counts. The open deals behind the measures, paged (pageNoLimit for an export, up to 2,000). Refuses a caller without SALES_REPORT_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED), an organization outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED), an unknown grouping (GROUPING_INVALID) and more than 2,000 deals (TOO_MANY_RECORDS).

WinLoss (design §8 OutcomeOptions, OutcomeResults): the deals a Sales report reader sees closed in a period (the calendar quarter holding the as-of time by default), under the filters (organization, team, owner, account, source, currency, lost reason). In the final-outcome mode (mode final, the default) each deal once, by its outcome and close date as of the report time; in the event mode (events) each close event in the period, a reopened deal's earlier closes among them. Won and lost counts and amounts by currency, never added across currencies; win rate as won over won and lost opportunities only; leads closed Lost (disqualified before qualification) counted apart; loss reasons (as recorded at the close) with counts and amounts by currency; average cycle time (created to closed) of won and of lost deals; the reopenings of the deals counted; the outcomes listed, paged (pageNoLimit for an export, up to 2,000). Refuses a caller without SALES_REPORT_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED), an organization outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED), an unknown mode (MODE_INVALID) and more than 2,000 deals (TOO_MANY_RECORDS).
